title: ci(governed-surface-guard): the pull_request leg checks out commits and trees only and installs the toolchain on demand
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8DRxWpNGUz2gv8QFn8EE47u)_
Fixes #26201
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**
受管面守卫(`Governed Surface Queue Guard`)在 PR 上的那一跑变轻了:只拉提交历史和目录树(不拉文件内容),工作区只铺开 `scripts/` 与 `.github/` 两个目录,默认不装依赖。合并队列那一跑(真正会拒绝的那条腿)一字未改;检查名不变;翻 ready 时守卫仍会重跑,这是它的设计初衷,保留。

**为什么改**
在手机上批准受管 PR 后马上点合并,会被「required status check is in progress」拒掉:批准后 PR 被翻成 ready,守卫重跑,那一跑约 95 秒里只有 1 秒在判定,其余是拉代码和装依赖。现在这一跑只做判定需要的事,窗口预计缩到二十秒以内;本 PR 自己那一跑的实测墙钟由席位定稿时补上。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**
- 判定不变:PR #25965(普通受管 PR)与 PR #25813(带生成型 skills 索引文件)上,新旧两种检出跑出的判定逐字节相同。
- 碰到 skills 下生成型索引文件的 PR(近 30 天约占 main 提交的 0.45%)仍会补回整棵树并装依赖,那一跑和以前一样慢,换来判定准确。
- 回滚:revert 本 PR 即恢复原样,无数据或配置残留。

**席位意见**


**你要做的**
审阅后批准或直接合并。本 PR 改了 `.github/workflows/`,属 Tier H,落地需要你本人。

## What changed

`.github/workflows/governed-surface-guard.yml`, the `pull_request` leg only:

- **Checkout.** The single checkout step is now two, keyed on the event. `merge_group` keeps the unchanged step (`Checkout repository`, `fetch-depth: 0`, full tree). `pull_request` gets `Checkout repository (commits and trees only)`: `fetch-depth: 0`, `filter: blob:none`, `sparse-checkout` of `scripts` and `.github`.
- **Toolchain on demand.** A new step asks the script `--toolchain-needed`. It runs on the `pull_request` leg only and appends `needed=true|false` to `$GITHUB_OUTPUT`. Every install step is gated on the output being NOT `'false'`, and so is a `git sparse-checkout disable` step that restores the full tree first. A skipped question (the queue leg) or a failed one therefore leaves the output empty and installs, which is the previous behaviour.
- **Unchanged:** `types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]`, the `merge_group` trigger, the job id `governed-surface-guard`, the check-run name `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, permissions, concurrency, timeouts and the judgment step.
- **Header.** The `ready_for_review` note gains the reason this leg is kept cheap rather than dropped. The "Both legs install" paragraph now reads "wherever the recompute can change the answer".

`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`:

- `toolchainNeededFor(rows)` is the one predicate. `liftGeneratedExceptions` now consults the recompute iff it answers true, and the workflow installs iff `--toolchain-needed` answers true. Membership is still the register's `generatedExceptionFor`; no path list is restated.
- `readEventDiff(env)` is extracted from `main()` so the judgment and the toolchain question read the event and the diff one way. The judgment's messages and exit codes are unchanged.
- `toolchainNeededAnswer({ eventName, read })` is pure. It answers `false` only for a `pull_request` diff that was read and touches no register path.
- New self-test battery, 20 cases, roster floor 28 → 29. Its pure half covers the predicate, the lift spy agreeing with it, and the answer per event and read state. Its YAML half covers exactly two checkouts (queue one unchanged; PR one blobless and sparse), the question wired to `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` on the PR leg only, every install step gated on not-`false` with no `== 'true'` spelling anywhere, the restore step ahead of the install, and an unconditional judgment step. `installStepAudit` gains a `stepBodies` field with comment lines dropped.

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`: the LIVE pin "exactly one family classifies CI-measured" became false because of this change. `--toolchain-needed` reads the event payload, so the live derivation now sees two CI-measured invocations of the one guard. The pin now names both.

## Route taken against the dispatch hypotheses

- **Route 2 taken; route 1 not taken.** `ready_for_review` stays in `types:`, and the header's reason for it stands.
- **The dispatch's framing of route 2 was "no checkout of the full tree, no pnpm install". Measured, both halves needed a qualifier.**
  - The `pull_request` leg is not API-only. Its judgment reads git history: `merge-base`, `log --first-parent`, `diff-tree --name-only`. Those need commits and trees, not blobs. So the leg keeps `fetch-depth: 0` (the #9902 reason holds on this leg too) and drops only the blobs.
  - The workflow header gives a stated reason for installing on both legs: the `pull_request` leg forecasts the queue verdict, and without the generator toolchain it forecasts a refusal the queue will not make. So the install is not dropped. It is acquired exactly when the lift would recompute, decided by the same predicate the lift uses.
- **Not done:** no copy of the script is vendored, and `actions/github-script` is not used.

## Premises (re-measured on `be531f685`, the branch base)

- **P1 holds.** `git grep -n 'ready_for_review'` on the workflow finds 2 lines: the `types:` line and one header comment. Control `synchronize`: 1 line.
- **P2 holds.** The check-runs on `e7b12fdd`, filtered to `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, are two runs. Run 121428970465 ran 06:21:40Z → 06:22:56Z, before the ready flip. The ready-fired run 121656663464 ran 15:12:37Z → 15:14:11Z (94 s).
- **P3 measured.** Tree reads: the event payload, `.github/CODEOWNERS`, the workflow file and its own sources under `scripts/`, plus git objects (commits and trees only). API reads: reviews, the pull object, comments and the timeline, all at the existing `pull-requests: read`. The static and lazy import graph is `node:` built-ins plus relative `scripts/**` modules only. Measured by running `--self-test` on an archive of just `scripts/` and `.github/` with no `node_modules`: 373 cases pass at base, exit 0.

## Measurements (dev container, 2026-10-26, repository `objectstack-ai/objectstack`)

- **Clone cost of full history.**
  - blobless: 7 s, 105 MiB
  - treeless: 3 s, 64 MiB
  - with contents: 58 s, 956 MiB
- **Sparse checkout** of `scripts` and `.github` on the blobless clone: 2.7 s.
- **Restoring the full tree** (`git sparse-checkout disable`) for the toolchain case: 26 s. Then `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` on a warm store: 13 s.
- **Judgment, PR #25965** (governed workflow file, no register path): blobless sparse checkout against a full checkout gives byte-identical output, exit 0 on both. `--toolchain-needed` answers `needed=false` on `pull_request` and `needed=true` on `merge_group`.
- **Judgment, PR #25813** (two `skills/*/references/_index.md` files): `--toolchain-needed` answers `needed=true` and names both paths. After the restore step and the install, the judgment is byte-identical to a full checkout with an install, and the same rows LIFTED. Without the toolchain on the sparse tree, every row stays governed: fail-closed, as before.
- **Frequency.** 14 of the 3142 commits reachable from `main` at `be531f685` since 2026-09-26 touched a register path. Counted on a full, non-shallow clone with `git rev-list --count --since` and a path-limited `git log`.

## Acceptance

- **"Approving and readying a governed PR starts no new guard run" is not met by design.** Route 1 is what would meet it, and the dispatch kept `ready_for_review` (route 2). The ready flip still starts a run, now a short one. This is the card's second acceptance arm.
- **"The `pull_request` leg's wall time is under 20 s":** NOT MEASURED at PR open. The workflow starts only on `pull_request` and `merge_group`, so this PR's own guard run is the first measurement. It is quoted by the seat when it posts the review record.
- **`Governed Surface Queue Guard` remains the check-run name on both legs.** The job and its `name:` are untouched. The self-test's WIRING pin and `check:required-contexts` both pass.

## Tests and gates (final head `8cd23c77`, after merging `origin/main`)

- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, 393 cases pass.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`: 1899 cases pass (fast tier), 313.4 s. Run detached; the verdict line is quoted and there is no `ELIFECYCLE`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 52 local commands. All 52 exit 0 on `8cd23c77`, each exit code captured before any pipe. That set includes `check:required-contexts`, `check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-step-collectors` (658 steps, 40 workflows), `check:pm-expected-skips`, `check:workflow-step-name-quoting` and `check:nul-bytes`.
- Two runs were added outside the derivation: `node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs --self-test` (174 assertions) and `node scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs --self-test` (173 cases), both exit 0.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 51 derived, 51 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. It is a derived zero, because every family recorded an exit code.
- No ablation: a workflow and a gate script are changed, and their pins are the self-test cases above.

## Acceptance notes

- The `skip-changeset` label is declared at create. Nothing under `.github/workflows/**` or `scripts/pm/**` ships in any package's `files[]`.
- The rare toolchain case pays about 26 s to restore the tree, in place of about 48 s of full-content checkout. Its wall stays roughly where it was.
